Burning Edict. When you cast Compelled Duel on a creature and it fails its saving throw, you ignore all of that creature’s damage Resistances when you deal damage to it, in addition to the spell’s normal effects.

Saint’s Reprieve. When you must make a Death Saving Throw, you may expend a use of your Channel Divinity. If you do so, you regain Hit Points equal to your Paladin level + the roll of your Death Saving Throw. Until the start of your next turn, you can use a Bonus action to make an attack with Advantage on the roll.
